contentPattern: 1 row, 2 columns: cell 1 = promo image (optionally linked); cell 2 = heading (H2), paragraph(s), CTA link in its own paragraph (last link-only paragraph, always rendered as the outlined secondary pill). The block paints the full-bleed orange band and the decorative dotted-pattern shadow (columns-event-dot-pattern.png) behind the image; image renders left, copy right, stacked on mobile.
